methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $32M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $1.8B.

data.narrative:
Gritt is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $32.4M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable, all operating in the robotics and manufacturing sector at seed through Series B stages. Lead private peers include Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Walden Robotics, Divergent, and Exotec.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage step-ups, yields $65M. Peer-median analysis across three directly comparable companies—Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B (Series B), Dexterity at $1.6B (Series B), and Walden Robotics at $1.1B (Seed)—produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $1.8B. The wide dispersion reflects stage heterogeneity within the peer set, with Series B companies commanding significantly higher valuations than seed-stage counterparts.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $55M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $857M. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively on deployed capital; the peer-median reflects market pricing for robotics companies but carries material uncertainty due to the wide spread between seed and Series B valuations. Key unknowns include Gritt's revenue profile, unit economics, and whether peer multiples reflect sector fundamentals or exuberant 2021-2022 funding conditions.
